question: 3Q Spread: Broncos (-3.5)
rules:
In the third quarter of the NFL game between Broncos and Cardinals, scheduled for October 25 at 4:05 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Broncos" if the Broncos outscore the Cardinals by 4 or more points in the third quarter.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to "Cardinals".

Only points scored during that period count; overtime is not included.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
